snippet.title: AltLife - Life Simulator (Trailer)
snippet.description:
Download now on the Google Play Store
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.QmzApps.LifeStory&hl=en_US

iOS coming soon!

🌟 Your Choices, Your Life Sim Journey, Your AltLife 🌟

Dive into AltLife, a free text-based life simulation game where each tap on the "Age" button uniquely shapes your life story.

📖 User-Friendly, One-of-a-Kind Life Simulation Game
Navigate an intuitive and simple-to-understand UI as you experience a different life with each tap of the 'Age' button. Our game's core mechanics revolve around straightforward pop-ups and unique random events, making it easy for you to grow older year by year and shape your personalized life sim story.

👩‍💼 Career Growth in Our Life Simulation Game
Start your life sim as a Dishwasher and aim for CEO greatness. Diverse job opportunities offer numerous routes to career success.

📱 Become a YouTuber or Instagram Star
Kickstart your virtual career on platforms known as YouTube and Instagram, or as they're called in-game, Utoob and Instafame. Go viral, land sponsorships, gain millions of followers, and make millions as you unlock unique career paths.

💞 Authentic Relationships with Depth in Our Life Simulator
Forge meaningful friendships and romantic connections with NPCs. As you get to know people better, unlock a variety of interaction choices that deepen your bonds or create tension. Experience the highs and lows of relationships, from engagements where you'll need to buy a ring and plan a wedding on a budget, to the potential for rivalry and even cheating. It's a rollercoaster of emotion, adding true-to-life complexity to your life simulation journey.

👤 Customize Your Avatar
Get creative with your character's appearance by selecting various eyewear, headwear, and tattoos. Change your hair and beard color and watch as wrinkles appear over time. Manage real-life challenges like acne with anti-acne cream, making your life sim experience truly unique.

🎲 Age Simulator with Skill Upgrades & Diverse Activities
Your life in AltLife is a rich tapestry of work and play. Develop a range of skills like cooking, writing, gaming, and handiness that will directly impact various aspects of your in-game life. Alongside skill-building, enjoy a wide array of activities like shopping, the lottery, and much more to enrich your life simulation experience.

🎒 Collect & Shop for Items
From food & drinks to books and electronics, your shopping choices directly impact your life simulation journey. Upgrade your lifestyle with a new computer or smartphone, or delve into the black market for riskier acquisitions like weapons.

💎 Smart Investments & Asset Growth
From cryptocurrency to commercial real estate, explore limitless investment opportunities. Start with a small coffee shop and level up to own stadiums, luxury mansions, or skyscrapers. Rent, sublet, or flip properties to grow your assets. Plus, hire tax accountants to optimize your earnings and minimize taxes. Diversify your investment portfolio for exponential financial growth in this engaging life simulation game.

🚔 Crime & Minigames
Add a dash of danger with criminal activities. Test your skills in pickpocketing and grand theft auto minigames. Whether you're a master thief or a casual pickpocket, crime brings an edge to your life simulation game experience.

🔄 Endless Generations
Secure endless replay value by passing your hard-earned assets to your children. With this feature, each new generation can continue to build upon your legacy, making your life simulation journey truly endless.
